 Jorko has made the step up to the big stage with Liquid 
 November 12, 2026 07:52 PM 
 Written by benji_cs2 
 Jorko, nEMANHA among eligible players for HLTV Rookie of the Year 2026
 Wildcard's IGL is a late bloomer. 
 Liquid AWPer Georgi "⁠Jorko⁠" Mitev Wildcard's IGL Nemanja "nEMANHA" Đukić have been named as eligible for the HLTV Rookie of the Year award .
 Jorko got his shot at T1 CS with Liquid, where he replaced Roland "ultimate" Tomkowiak. nEMANHA, on the other hand, signed with Wildcard from illwill amid the NA team's 2026 rebuild.
 Also read: FACEIT to add four new NA server locations with Season 10 launch 
 Liquid's Bulgarian AWPer has held his own for the NA side since joining in July. Jorko has averaged a 1.04 rating in 87 maps played.
 nEMANHA has shown that age is just a number, as the Serbian is up for the Rookie of the Year award at the age of 29. The criteria for rookie of the year has nothing to do with age, though. One becomes eligible for the award in their breakout year in tier-one CS .
 The two NA adjacent players are definitely on the outside looking in at winning the actual award. Among the contenders to take home the hardware are FUT's star duo of Džiugas "dziugss" Steponavičius and Dmytro "dem0n" Myroshnychenko, and MOUZ's Adrian "xelex" Vincze, to name a few.
 Here are the criteria for 2026 Rookie of the Year eligibility:
 As of December 31st, 2025:
 Maps versus Top 20 opposition: <60
 Maps versus Top 20 opposition on LAN: <30
 Maps in Big Event playoffs: <10
 Maps in Major playoffs: <1
 Both Jorko and nEMANHA will be making their Major debuts at the PGL Major Singapore.
